name: tm48
effect: Teaches Skill Swap to a compatible Pokémon.
short_effect: Teaches Round to a compatible Pokémon. (Gen IV & III: Skill Swap Gen II: Fire Punch Gen I: Rock Slide)

flavor_text.sun-moon: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.
flavor_text.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.
flavor_text.lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.
